title: Evaluation Metrics in the Era of GPT-4: Reliably Evaluating Large Language Models on Sequence to Sequence Tasks
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating LLM performance on sequence-to-sequence tasks (summarization, simplification, GEC) using automatic and human evaluation criteria such as relevance, fluency, coherence, consistency, semantics, simplicity, grammaticality, and over-correction. These criteria do not include components related to religion, morals, or ethics. The brief 'Ethics Statement' section is a general disclaimer and not part of the evaluation framework itself.
